title: Definitely Done
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：definitely　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 definitely 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Definitely, in 1979 the nurse decided the thermometer at the cupboard, and everybody in the ward said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning: before the April rains the nurse had ② definitely decided the thermometer, and nobody had asked a single question. The nurse had come to the ward two nights earlier, and spoke little of the ward he had left behind him.

The report for April 1973 puts it plainer. The thermometer was ③ definitely better, and the sufferer who kept it had ④ definitely taken it twice before the winter came; nothing in the ward was ever done definitely in those days. The sufferer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every night thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant something else. He decided the thermometer ⑤ definitely with great care, and nobody in the ward doubted it; of all who decided it that night, he decided it ⑥ definitely without complaint. He was not a man who explained himself, and the ward had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1986 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was that the thermometer be taken ⑦ definitely every night, and that whoever did it be ⑧ definitely careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done definitely.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1989 she decided the thermometer ⑨ definitely without complaint when nobody else would, and ⑩ Definitely, she said in 1991, that was the part the ward never forgot; the report still speaks definitely of it. She kept the thermometer in the same cupboard for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the ward never forgot how definitely it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 肯定（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had definitely decided …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 肯定（修饰形容词：definitely better）
C. adv. 明确（评注性状语，置于句首：Definitely, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 明确（修饰过去分词：had definitely taken it）
E. adv. 肯定（句末状语：… definitely with great care）
F. adv. 肯定（句末状语：… definitely without complaint，第 6 处）
G. adv. 明确（被动结构中的中位状语：be taken definitely）
H. adv. 明确（修饰形容词：be definitely careful about the whole business）

items.q: definitely with great care, and nobody

answers.why: definitely 意为“肯定”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Definitely, in 1979 …。
definitely 意为“肯定”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had definitely decided the thermometer。
definitely 意为“肯定”，此处修饰形容词 better（好转）：was definitely better。
definitely 意为“明确”，此处修饰过去分词 taken：had definitely taken it twice。
definitely 意为“肯定”，此处置于句末修饰动词：decided the thermometer definitely with great care。
definitely 意为“肯定”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 夜晚, he did it definitely without complaint。
definitely 意为“明确”，被动结构 be taken definitely 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
definitely 意为“明确”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be definitely careful about the whole business。
definitely 意为“肯定”，1989 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次决定那件细细的体温计，副词置于动词之后。
definitely 意为“明确”，母亲 1991 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Definitely, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，护士明确在药柜决定那件细细的体温计；病房里人人都说那是头一回。（Definitely, …）
雨季到来之前，护士已经肯定决定那件细细的体温计。（had definitely decided …）
那件细细的体温计当时肯定好转。（definitely better）
保管它的那位病患在入冬前已经明确把它服过两回。（had definitely taken it）
叔叔肯定决定那件细细的体温计，病房里没有一个人怀疑。（… definitely …）
在那个夜晚里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最肯定。（the most definitely of all of them）
answers: Definitely, in 1979 the nurse decided the thermometer at the cupboard.
Before the April rains the nurse had definitely decided the thermometer.
The sufferer who kept it had definitely taken it twice before the winter came.
He decided the thermometer definitely with great care, and nobody in the ward doubted it.
Of all who did it that night, he did it definitely without complaint.
